attributes.name: hero_photo_treatment
attributes.definition: Whether the hero area uses a full-width photograph and whether it carries a color overlay.

values.definition: Hero is a full-width photograph tinted with a color overlay.
Hero is a full-width photograph with no color overlay.
No photographic hero is used, or intro content is not placed over a photo.

attributes.name: intro_section_placement
attributes.definition: Where the introductory/about content sits relative to the hero and how it is arranged.

values.definition: Intro text is placed on top of the hero image.
Intro sits beneath the hero in a two-column layout.
Intro sits beneath the hero in a single-column layout.
Intro is arranged some other way or absent.

attributes.name: hero_position_relative_to_header
attributes.definition: Where the hero sits in the page flow relative to the header.

values.definition: Hero extends behind or under a transparent header.
